mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic demand, which compresses discount rates on equity valuations and boosts investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained upward trend in GDPC1, or the trend reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1% triggers monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on future cash flows and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 1%, or the rate does not sustain above 1% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly employment growth (HOUST) indicates robust demand across sectors, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which depresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 5.5%, or the rate does not sustain the threshold for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous high supply growth (INDPRO) and rising demand (GDPC1) signal sustainable economic momentum, lowering risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the late-cycle indicators, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate paired with a decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) signals monetary policy normalization with cooling inflation, reducing policy uncertainty and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the inverse relationship between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 145,000 indicates labor market overexpansion, raising concerns about wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, which depresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS exceeding 145,000, or the rate does not sustain the threshold for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, simultaneous growth in demand (RSAFS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals economic resilience, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the interaction between RSAFS and UNRATE, or the combined effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).
